name: Eloa
positioning: SaaS platform for French credit intermediaries, whose eCredits module runs a mortgage file against the broker's own bank agreements.
description: Eloa publishes a family of SaaS products for French credit intermediaries. Its real estate module, eCredits, handles a mortgage file from simulation to funding: pre-qualification simulators covering amortising, in fine, relay, staged and PTZ loans, bank convention and rate-schedule configuration, document collection, commission and invoicing rules, and activity ratios. A separate eImmo line covers rental, renovation and condominium financing. The company also sells unrelated modules for used-vehicle dealers.
real_estate_use: A credit broker configures Eloa with the bank agreements they actually hold: rate schedules, required documents, commission terms, branch coverage. From there a borrower profile produces personalised simulations against those specific banks rather than against generic rates, which is the comparison work that is the broker's job. Rights management and document completeness rules are set per firm, so a national network of mandataires and a one-person brokerage can run on the same product with different process rules. The vendor also markets a condominium loan module used by syndics financing building works.
features: Loan simulators covering amortising, in fine, relay, staged and PTZ structures
Configuration of bank conventions, rate schedules and required documents
Automatic file creation from the simulation, avoiding double entry
Rights management and per-firm process configuration

use_cases.job: Compare personalised loan plans against the broker's own bank agreements instead of published market rates
Arrange a collective loan to finance works voted by a condominium

capabilities: assisted preparation and processing of loan files
